sentence: The third is coverage: samples from the United States and China make up 47.8 percent of the corpus, and two thirds of the studies (65.7 percent) appeared in 2025 and 2026, so long-run outcomes are largely unobservable, and the one study that decomposes the effect over time finds it slowing already
passage: [Sun et al. (2024), p. 1] "the dynamic decomposition effect shows that the productivity-enhancing effect of AI is slowing down in the long run."

gemini.note: The passage confirms the study's finding that dynamic decomposition shows the effect of AI slowing down over time.
